findings.fsdQuote: The On Deck row shows up to 50 series.
findings.note: The On Deck row has no 50-series cap: it loads 20 at a time and keeps paging for more.

findings.fsdQuote: Each row on the Home screen can be collapsed, and Kavita remembers the choice on the next visit.
findings.note: Home rows are carousels with no collapse control and nothing remembers a collapsed state.

findings.fsdQuote: A Random button on the library screen opens a randomly chosen series from that library.
findings.note: The library screen has no Random button; only name, actions menu, series count, filter, jump bar and bulk actions.

findings.fsdQuote: Manga series open on the Volumes tab by default.
findings.note: For manga (and other non-comic, non-book libraries) the default tab is Storyline, not Volumes.

findings.fsdQuote: Users can keep a private note on a series that only they can see.
findings.note: No private series note feature exists in the series detail screen or series service.
Series screen has Annotations and Activity (reading history) tabs that the FSD tab list does not mention.

findings.fsdQuote: A chapter's screen shows its release date, writers, cover artists, genres and tags
findings.note: Release date is only shown for Comic and Comic (Flexible)/ComicVine libraries, and only if not the null date.

findings.fsdQuote: Brightness can be set anywhere from 0% to 100%.
findings.note: Brightness slider is limited to a minimum of 10% (10 to 100).

findings.fsdQuote: A slideshow mode turns the page automatically after a set number of seconds.
findings.note: The image reader has no slideshow or auto-advance mode.
Layout dropdown has a fourth option, Double (No Cover), where cover images split, besides one page, two pages and two pages in manga order.
Image reader has a Width Override slider that the FSD does not mention.
Image reader has Emulate Comic Book and Page Offset switches, plus auto-close menu and swipe-to-paginate switches, none described.

findings.fsdQuote: Font size can be set from 50% to 200%.
findings.note: The font size limit in the book reader settings is 50% to 300%.

findings.fsdQuote: Selected text can be read aloud using the device's text-to-speech voice.
findings.note: No text-to-speech or read-aloud feature exists in the book reader.
A PDF reader screen exists; the FSD says only archive/image and EPUB files open in readers.

findings.fsdQuote: Kavita removes a series from Want to Read automatically as soon as the user finishes reading it.
findings.note: Removal runs as a daily job and only for series that are Completed or Cancelled and fully read, not immediately on finishing.

findings.fsdQuote: The series in a collection can be exported to a CSV file.
findings.note: Collection actions are only Edit, Download, Delete, Promote and Unpromote; no CSV export exists.
Collections synced from an outside service have a Sync Details button opening a drawer with sync information.

findings.fsdQuote: The owner can share a reading list through a public link that opens without signing in.
findings.note: No share or public link feature exists for reading lists in the UI or controller.

findings.fsdQuote: A filter box for finding items appears once a list has more than 25 items.
findings.note: The filter box appears when a list has more than 10 items.
In reorder mode an unpromoted owned list has a Remove Read button that removes read items; also a missing-items count is shown.
Reading list actions menu includes Refresh Metadata, Download and Export as CBL (v1/v2), not mentioned.
A Browse Genres screen lists genres with series and issue counts and opens All Series filtered to the genre; the FSD describes only People and Tags.
A Browse Annotations screen exists (all annotations with filter) and is not described.
Person page actions menu has admin-only Edit and Merge person actions, and shows web link icons.

findings.fsdQuote: Users can turn on two-factor sign-in with an authenticator app.
findings.note: No two-factor or authenticator feature exists in the Account page or controllers.

findings.fsdQuote: A new password must be at least 8 characters long.
findings.note: The minimum password length is 6 characters.

findings.fsdQuote: When Prompt on Download is on, Kavita asks for confirmation before any download larger than 500 MB.
findings.note: The threshold is 100 MB (tooltip also says 100 MB).
Preferences has On Deck progress-days and update-days settings that control the On Deck row.
Preferences has Blur Unread Summaries and Collapse Series Relationships switches.

findings.fsdQuote: Changes on this page are stored only when the administrator presses Save.
findings.note: There is no Save button; valid changes are saved automatically after a 300 ms debounce.

findings.fsdQuote: A maintenance mode switch blocks all non-admin users from signing in until it is turned off.
findings.note: No maintenance mode setting exists in the General settings page or server settings.
General page has a Logging Level selector and per-field reset buttons for base URL and IP addresses.

findings.fsdQuote: An invite can be given an expiry date, after which its link stops working.
findings.note: The invite form has no expiry date field.
Users rows also have a Change Password button and a profile link; the FSD lists only edit, delete, resend and set up.

findings.fsdQuote: Manage Collections is turned on by default for a new library.
findings.note: The Add Library form starts with Manage Collections off (the entity default is on).
Libraries page has a bulk action menu with row selection (copy settings, scan, covers, delete) not described.
